exclusions.title: Training-phase emissions
exclusions.statement: Emissions from training the models are not included. EcoLogits covers inference only; allocating training to each request would need separate amortization modelling, which is not performed.
exclusions.remediation: Request training-emissions disclosures from each provider and report them separately if they publish them.

exclusions.title: Network and data-transit emissions
exclusions.statement: Emissions from carrying data between your users and the data center are outside the boundary.
exclusions.remediation: Estimate network emissions with your own network or telecom methodology if material.

exclusions.title: End-user device energy
exclusions.statement: Energy used by the laptops, phones and browsers that send prompts and read answers is outside the boundary.
exclusions.remediation: Cover device energy through your own-operations (Scope 1 and 2) inventory.

exclusions.title: Embodied water in hardware manufacturing
exclusions.statement: Water used to manufacture servers and GPUs is not computed. This is an acknowledged data gap in the EcoLogits methodology.
exclusions.remediation: Request manufacturing water data from hardware and cloud providers.

exclusions.title: End-of-life and e-waste
exclusions.statement: Disposal and recycling of hardware is excluded for lack of recycling-rate data.
exclusions.remediation: Request end-of-life data from providers as it becomes available.

exclusions.title: Input-token (prefill) energy
exclusions.statement: Energy for processing prompts is not yet modelled, so long-context, retrieval (RAG) and coding workloads are understated. Reference point: 10,000 input tokens can raise consumption by roughly 8x.
exclusions.remediation: Track input-to-output ratios; this warning fires automatically for teams whose average exceeds 5.

exclusions.title: Market-based Scope 2
exclusions.statement: Figures use national-average, location-based grid mixes. Power purchase agreements and renewable-energy certificates are not accounted for.
exclusions.remediation: If a provider publishes market-based data, register it as a supplier-specific figure and report it separately.
